correctness.rationale: The verifier enumerates and independently reconciles all 950 faces from the full 2^20 subset universe; checks 446 valid pairs and all 3260 Hasse incidences, establishes acyclicity by topological sorting, computes zero signed integral boundary twice (gradient recursion and direct unit pivots), and Hurewicz yields nullhomotopic 3-cell attachments from the simply connected wedge of 53 two-spheres. Fixed finite classification is a complete exhaustive proof, not an extrapolation.

value.rationale: The four-cycle violates the unique-middle-neighbor hypothesis of the published n>=5 classification. Choosing m=5 is the smallest clique size with genuinely distinct S2 and S3 dimensions, and the result gives the complete integral homotopy boundary condition, not only a face-count/Euler characteristic or known-table recomputation. It provides a concrete starting point to develop short-period family theorems and a meaningful exception to the longer-cycle graph-product topology.
